title: Notified "Files have been modified outside Godot" when file are not modified by user
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 release

### System information

Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS

### Issue description

On some of my projects converted from 4.3, I will get the "Files have been modified outside Godot" dialog for the same set of gdscript files. Even after selecting "Reload from Disk", the dialog may reappear after debugging or refocusing the Editor.

This persists after the project is reloaded.

Modifying and then saving the file in the Script Editor temporarily fixes the problem, but the problem will return the next time the project is loaded in the Editor, and only after debug is run on any scene (it won't appear on refocus until after debug is run at least once).

I checked the UID and it shares no duplicates in the project.
Upgrading the UIDs again has no effect.
Renaming the files has no effect.
Changing the folder of the files has no effect.
Removing the script from all scenes and other scripts that use it has no effect.

I did try modifying ``script_editor_plugin.cpp`` so it prints the ``last_date`` and ``date`` in ``_test_script_times_on_disk()``, where it checks for the mismatch and adds it to the ``disk_changed_list``.
I printed only when a mismatch happened

```
1741584168 : last_date
1741585533 : date
```

After saving the trouble file once, then reloading the project, I got different times:

```
1741585556 : last_date
1741585575 : date
```

Then I tried just reloading the project without changing anything, and got new times again:

```
1741585575 : last_date
1741585919 : date
```

Notably, the ``date`` was pushed to ``last_date`` when just reloading the project. This behavior appears to be consistent when just reloading the project while the bug is active.


### Steps to reproduce

I haven't found a cause/source.
